No written duty-manager permission is registered. The 9 October note is only a request for the next approval sitting, which is tomorrow at 09:00. Operators do not grant discretionary extensions, and this morning’s instruction was explicit: no discretionary extensions this cycle, and release the full batch on time. Permissions are registered only at Tuesday and Thursday sittings, so none can be registered before the 13:30 release.

Nobody authorised can collect before Wednesday, so a return handover today is not possible. The box therefore follows the normal end-of-storage path: destruction collection at 14:30. The contents being unique does not create an operator exception under this policy.
